Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on a loading charge, so it is a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted, and no contract formed; the team note misreads 2-207(2), which applies only after a contract already exists.

Q6156.reason: The deposition is former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1): the engineer is unavailable, and the company, as the adverse party that took the deposition, had opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine on the same safety-report issue; the team note wrongly says the company had no motive.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the Court found no Article 6 violation from applying state immunity, so the immunity rule was not held to conflict with the fair-trial right; the team note overstates the holding.
